base: The MIDI extra-hit step on Scatter v1.3 (75f9f392a228ac50779d2dd0107db2d716a6fa95e8ea5d5d9aab7fe9ae70edc2)
changes: Start-up: the last start-up call (0x080093A0, bl 0x08004E9C) goes through BOOT (134 bytes at 0x0800D464), which reads the 32 records at slot * 64 + 22 into CACHE and gives the loaded pattern its lengths.

Pattern loads: 0x0800366A in the stock load of the playing pattern (bl 0x08005B70, the tidy-up) goes through LOAD (36 bytes at 0x0800D328), which then copies the pattern's lengths from CACHE to v1.3's LEN through APPLY (38 bytes at 0x0800D300).

Setting a length: v1.3 set_length's store at 0x0800D1C0 (strb.w r1, [r0, #0x2C]) goes through SET (100 bytes at 0x0800D34C), which also stores the length in CACHE for the playing pattern's slot and marks the slot, with interrupts masked.

Saving: 0x080072F6 in the main loop's save (bl 0x08003760, the song save) goes through SAVE (180 bytes at 0x0800D3B0), which writes one marked slot's 10-byte record, reads it back and retries a failed write at the next 3 saves.

Pattern Write's lights: 0x080064EA in the light builder (bl 0x0800CD90, v1.2's step routine) goes through SHOW (100 bytes at 0x0800D4EC): while playing in Pattern Write with a voice of its own length selected, the running light shows the step that voice last played and its steps past the length are dark.

Length view: PANEL's let-go check at 0x0800D08E (add.w r0, fp, r6, lsl #3) goes through LATCH (82 bytes at 0x0800D550), which keeps HELD when the voice's button is let go with its length on show and none chosen, so a step press (the voice's own button included) or TAP sets it, and closes the view after 5 x WINDOW ticks; p_plain's HELD store at 0x0800D11E goes through NEWHOLD (16 bytes at 0x0800D5A4), which starts each hold unchosen and unlatched; SET also marks the hold as chosen and restarts a latched view's time, so the view shows the new length for another 5 x WINDOW ticks.
RAM: LATCHED, CHOSEN and LATCH_T at 0x20002158-0x2000215F; LOADED, FAILS, DIRTY and CACHE at 0x20002160-0x20002267; v1.2's start-up clear of 0x20002000 grows from 0x158 to 0x268 bytes (0x0800BC58).
scope: Offline: byte diff against the MIDI step, every branch against the listing, mask recoverability. source/rd6_thumb_machine.py runs the actual bytes, with the stock EEPROM routines replaced by stubs on a model of the 32 KB EEPROM (page-wrapping writes). 14 length-view gestures on v1.3's panel code. The light builder beside the MIDI step in 2,000 random states. Not the I2C timing, a timer's pattern load cutting into a save on hardware, or EEPROM wear. Simulated installs in the updater.
hardware_test: Confirmed on the test unit on 2026-10-23: installed from a local copy of the updater; the user reported that it works, with voices taking their own button's length and the lights showing the new length. v1.4 was confirmed on 2026-10-18.
